newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Telecon to buy two Florida firms.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Telecon to buy two Florida firms.

text.p: Speciality Teleconstructors Inc said Monday it had signed letters of intent to acquire two Fort Lauderdale, Fla., electronic service firms.
Speciality Teleconstructors said it intends to pay a total of 851,064 newly issued shares to acquire Microcell Communications of America Inc and Ellis Tower Co Inc.
It said it will account for the transactions as poolings of interest.
The proposed acquisitions are subject to execution of definitive agreements, Spciality Teleconstructors said.
Specialty Teleconstructors, which has 11 regional offices across the country, builds and maintains wireless communications transmitting and receving facilities for wireless communications providers.
Microcell installs and repairs radio and other electronic wireless equipment. Tower builds and maintains wireless transmittinmg and receiving facilities.
